notes: The post calls this an 'Episode 1 Closed' deck, so the format is Episode I Closed Environment; Sense, Alter and Control dested the Dark Coruscant printings.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (6): Tatooine: Desert Landing Site ('Mauls Hut'), Start Your Engines!, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Watto's Box; these count toward the 60. No objective.

Posted 'Sebulba' in the starting cards dested Sebulba's Podracer (Start Your Engines! deploys Podrace Arena with a Podracer); 'Boooonta Eve' dested Boonta Eve Podrace; 'Start the Engines' dested Start Your Engines!.
Posted 'Sith Droid x4' dested Sith Probe Droid (the strategy retrieves with them; If The Trace Was Correct fetches them); 'Grotto' dested Grotto Werribee; 'P-69' dested P-60.
Posted 'Tatooine Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'Coruscant Maul' dested Darth Maul, Young Apprentice; 'Mauls Stick' dested Maul's Lightsaber.

Posted joke spellings 'We Must Accelerate Our Pants', 'Llama Dobreed', 'Rune Haaaaaaaako' and 'Daulty Dofine' dested We Must Accelerate Our Plans, Lana Dobreed (Interrupt), Rune Haako and Daultay Dofine.
Section headers 'Locales (1)', 'Guys (21)' and 'Effects and Events (6)' were dropped from the card rows.
